service.description: Run service calls one after another in one sim run, as the current user (each service's own authorization applies) and under the sim fence an approval's preview uses: entity writes go into the overlay, and an outside effect (a resource write, mail, a notification, a remote call) is refused. Each step runs under its own savepoint: a step that fails (an error, a refused outside effect, a transaction it rolled back) is rolled back to it, with the sim's state, and the next step runs. Sequenced ids in the sim are negative. With no sim overlay in this process, available is false and nothing runs.

parameter.name: steps
parameter.description: Each a Map of serviceName and parameters (a Map).

parameter.name: read
parameter.description: A service run after all steps (and after each step with readAfterEachStep), as serviceName and parameters; what it writes is rolled back.

parameter.name: label
parameter.description: Names the run in the fence's refusals and the log.

parameter.name: steps
parameter.description: One Map per input step: ok, error (when not ok), rows (the rows this step changed, each {entity, key, action, fields: [{field, before, after}]} against the values before the step), moreRows (when it changed more than 50), createdKeys ([{entity, key}] of the rows it created), and with readAfterEachStep readResult (the read's out-parameters after this step) and readError (when the read failed).

parameter.name: readResult
parameter.description: The read's out-parameters after all steps.

parameter.name: readError
parameter.description: Why the read after all steps failed.
